title: HZR-050…HZR-200 - Deesys HIGH VOLTAGE zero-phase CT (ZCT), 6.6 / 3.3 kV
range_short_desc: High-voltage zero-phase current transformer (6.6 / 3.3 kV) for ground-fault relays
description: HIGH VOLTAGE product. Deesys HZR zero-phase sequence current transformer rated 6,600 / 3,300 V, for supporting ground-fault relays on high-voltage systems. Withstands 22,000 V AC for 1 minute between the primary conductor and the coil. Zero-phase primary current ratio 200 mA / 100 mV at a 2 kOhm load, in round cable-through bodies from inside diameter 50 mm up to 200 mm. This is NOT a low-voltage ZCT: for 600 V class installations use the DZR, DZS or SZR series instead.

feature_groups.title: High voltage rating
items: Rated voltage 6,600 / 3,300 V — high-voltage systems only

Designed for excellent usability and safety, more economical than conventional ZCT
Wide range of operating currents, conveniently structured for cabling networks
Light and easy for panel setting, with model choice according to the selected cable
